annotation.evidence_span: MUST NOT send the "early_data" extension with a max_early_data_size set to any value other than 0xffffffff.
annotation.interpretation_a: The server is prohibited from sending the extension with any value other than 0xffffffff.
annotation.interpretation_b: The server is prohibited from sending the extension with a value *different* than 0xffffffff, implying 0xffffffff is the only permitted value.
annotation.justification: The clause states the server "MUST NOT send...any value other than 0xffffffff". This can be interpreted as either (a) the server cannot send any value except 0xffffffff, or (b) the server cannot send a value that is not 0xffffffff. While seemingly similar, the latter allows for the possibility of sending 0xffffffff, while the former explicitly requires it. The difference is subtle but material.
